name: Page driver
responsibility: Waits until the page is ready, starts it from a user gesture, follows each step, then streams the voice out and reads the talk's events
description: Everything the page says crosses as the shared recording state or the talk's log and is parsed as such, so a page from another build is refused rather than guessed at.

outgoing.label: state, start, voice, talk
outgoing.description: Through the one global the page publishes, evaluated over the recorder's DevTools connection.
